name: Quanto Agroworld Limited
about: Quanto Agroworld Limited engages in the cultivation of aromatic crops and the production of specialty ingredients such as lemongrass-based botanical formats and essential oils. The company's products comprise lemongrass biomass, chunks, tea-cuts, and essential oils. Its products are used in various applications, such as essential oil manufacturing, agriculture, animal husbandry, pharmaceuticals, home and personal care, herbal teas and infusions, nutraceuticals, functional beverages, food and beverage, food processing, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, aromatherapy and wellness, and flavors and fragrances. In addition, it also engages in the business of operating, managing, and maintaining malls, shopping centres, commercial complexes, retail spaces, entertainment zones, and various immovable properties. The Company is also involved in the trading, buying, selling, importing, exporting, distributing, and supplying a wide range of goods including FMCG products, garments, electronics, home décor, furniture, jewellery, footwear, books, and other consumer merchandise. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Mumbai, India.
